title: Pictographs
info: Each picture stands for a number. The key tells you what one picture means.
If one apple picture means 2 apples, three pictures mean 6.

questions.q: The key of a pictograph tells
If one star means 5 books, two stars mean
If one face means 2 students, three faces mean
You must read the key because
options: a picture might mean more than one

questions.q: Half a picture, if the key allows it, can mean
options: half of what a whole picture means

questions.q: Type the word for the note that says what each picture means.
